correctness.rationale: Direct partition of the fixed point sets and a marked-preimage bijection give exactly binomial(c,t)*(b)_t*(a+t)^(b-t)*(a+b)^(c-t)*((a+b)(a+c))^d base pairs. Every x in T generates one independent group-label inverse equation because distinguished points in the disjoint fibers B_x are distinct, leaving |G|^(b+c+2d-t) lifts. These facts prove the universal rank polynomial. The largest |G|-power is 2n-2 with coefficient n, versus n^2 for independent idempotent pairs, proving the 1/n limit. The actual bundled checker enumerates independent true compositions in groups C2,C6,S3 and every rank-triple cell of base pairs n<=4; all agree. Risk: finite enumerations are supportive only, not a proof for arbitrary n or all finite groups; the supplied combinatorial bijection is the infinite argument.

value.rationale: This is a full natural triple-image-rank product invariant for endomorphisms of finite free G-acts for all n and every finite G, including nonabelian groups. Existing commuting-only lift laws omit noncommuting one-sided pairs; the formula supplies a weighted classification of all such directed product-idempotence events. Universality with respect to group order and a sharp fixed-n large-group-order probability limit yield structural information, not an arbitrary finite slice. Limit: no extension to arbitrary label semigroups or joint n and group-order asymptotics is claimed.
